priorities.title: Recheck the Christmas tree's base
priorities.why: DEC-016 already records a 16 × 16 stud base. Repeating the measurement lets us practice the M-01 flow without discarding that baseline.
priorities.unlocks: Use M-01 to compare a new reading with DEC-016 before changing the record.

priorities.title: Check the Winter Holiday Train listing
priorities.why: Set 10254 is the train in the design. Availability and price need a fresh check before any order.
priorities.unlocks: Record any order with its date and source in the future order workflow.

priorities.title: Confirm the rails fit around the tree
priorities.why: The inner corner overlaps the tree base in the design prototype. The measured geometry still needs a code check.
priorities.unlocks: Resolve the fit finding with measured geometry before buying module parts.
